comparison.objective: Extract a jammed printer card intact and resume printing, versus adjust and lock a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1739 requires symmetric two-hand pulling to avoid skew and tearing; the candidate requires rotational tool coordination and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1739 scores intact extraction, placement, and an OK-button action; the candidate scores locked angular accuracy and repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Balanced deformable-media extraction is unrelated to coupled screw-and-nut adjustment.
